rationale: Genome-wide Brunello KO screen in NK-92 Cas9 cells stimulated with target cells and sorted on surface CD107a (degranulation) into CD107a-high and CD107a-negative gates in two independent sorts. Counts are the GEO PoolQ table with a Gene column derived from 'Row Barcode IDs' by prepare.R; column names equal GSM library names. Knockouts of genes needed for degranulation are depleted from the CD107a-high gate relative to the negative gate. High and negative gates of one sort come from the same stimulated culture (within-sort correlation 0.82 and 0.75 vs 0.78-0.82 across), so the model pairs them with a sort term; this leaves 1 residual df, which BARCS moderates across guides (prior df 24). Because the pairing is not clearly supported by the correlations, the unpaired model (~ gate, residual df 2) is run as a sensitivity analysis. Plasmid and day-9/day-17 libraries are single references kept for context.
